forecastingTypeId.title: Forecasting Type ID
forecastingTypeId.description: Salesforce ID of the active ForecastingType, from Get_Forecasting_Context.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Salesforce User ID (005...) of the forecast owner, from Get_Forecasting_Context.

periodId.title: Period ID
periodId.description: Salesforce ID of the current ForecastingPeriod, from Get_Forecasting_Context.

territoryId.title: Territory ID
territoryId.description: Optional Territory2 ID for territory-hierarchy forecast types. Empty for non-territory types.

forecastingCategories.title: Forecasting Categories
forecastingCategories.description: Forecast category API names to drill into: the validated inputCategory when the user named a category, otherwise the type's forecastable displayed categories ({Commit, Best Case, Pipeline}; Closed/Most Likely/Omitted/Custom excluded). Derived from resolvedForecastingCategories.

includeHistory.title: Include History
includeHistory.description: Whether to populate prior-value columns. Optional; defaults to true when omitted.
